initialRejectedDraft.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one finished high-end Korean science-fiction game inventory equipment asset, part of a coherent four-piece MYTHIC SF equipment set. Art direction: the commanding hard-surface industrial armor language of Halo, elevated to an ancient hyper-advanced civilization relic. Original design, no existing franchise insignia or logos. Strong engineered armor geometry, broad beveled interlocking plates, deep graphite structural skeleton, pearlescent cold titanium-silver ceramic main plates, a few dark desaturated blue inset planes, very restrained pale champagne metal at precision joints (at most 5% of surface). Bright ice-blue and brilliant white energy emitters recessed into the structure with subtle controlled bloom. The prestige comes from pristine materials, a powerful sculptural silhouette, extreme engineering refinement, and impossibly advanced energy mechanisms. Tactile brushed metal, clean crisp panel separation, narrow machining grooves, robust physically coherent attachments. Premium polished 2D game item illustration with dimensional material lighting, not cartoon, not a gritty real-world military photograph, not cheap plastic. No medieval filigree, no engraved floral patterns, no jewels, no ruby/gem inlays, no angel wings, no cloth cape, no magic runes or sigils, no organic spikes, no crowns, no excessive micro-greebles, no text, no labels, no UI, no frame, no watermark. Isolated object on GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background; the entire silhouette must fit inside the square with 10% clean transparent margin. Soft cool studio lighting with a white rim and controlled ice-blue internal light. Orthographic-like product composition with slight three-quarter depth. Centered, elegant readability at inventory icon size. SUBJECT: One standalone UPPER-BODY ARMOR chest piece, from empty neck opening to waist. Include integrated substantial shoulder armor and compact upper-arm attachment plates but NO head, no helmet, no human body, no full arms, no hands, no legs. Broad heroic chest, restrained angular collar, distinctive horizontally split breastplate framing a small luminous white-blue hexagonal containment core at sternum. Two clean articulated shoulder caps with parallel recessed light fins. The torso narrows naturally at waist, layered abdominal plates are angular and mechanical. A heavy science-fiction combat cuirass, visually mythic and rare, with no knight-like scalloped edges. Presentation near frontal with slight view from above; left/right construction consistent. Single object only. Square high-resolution PNG.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one FINISHED SQUARE framed equipment icon for the highest tier of a premium science-fiction game, a new tier ABOVE the ornate Emperor equipment. The last plain trooper-armor direction was rejected for looking too ordinary. This must read immediately as an astonishingly rare, expensive, transcendent MYTHIC relic of an ancient hyper-advanced civilization. Halo-like hard-surface technology and monumental engineering, elevated far above standard military armor. Science fiction, not medieval fantasy. Strong authored shape language: sculptural layered platinum-white ceramic armor, deep obsidian inner machinery, blue-black titanium recesses, substantial highly polished pale-gold structural inlays, intensely luminous cyan-white contained plasma. Rich material contrast, heroic scale, deep interlocking tiers, precise suspended secondary armor segments held by visible short energy couplings, not a featureless grey mass. Broad intentional surfaces contrasted with precise intricate engineering in the recesses. Mesmerizing luminous energy apertures and controlled volumetric cyan-white radiance. Premium painted 2D game-item art with beautiful dimensional lighting and extraordinarily refined metal; not a rough sketch or plain generic 3D game model. No medieval scrollwork, no gemstones, no red jewels, no angel wings, no cloth, no organic thorns, no sword-like decorative spikes, no runes, no text, no names, no numbers, no UI labels, no logos, no watermark.
MANDATORY SQUARE ORNATE SCI-FI FRAME: Integrate a clearly visible, richly designed square artifact frame around all four edges. Layered platinum and pale-gold rails, recessed luminous cyan fiber channels, substantial sculptural chamfered corner mechanisms with small triangular blue energy chambers, an elegant raised techno-emblem centered on the top edge, a compact matching geometric clasp centered on the bottom edge. The top and corners carry the main visual weight; side rails are elegant medium-thin, not huge walls. Decorated engineering, NOT a plain rectangular line. Four true square corners; no round framing. Frame is 6–8 percent of canvas width and clearly separate from the equipment silhouette. No blank nameplate. Everything inside frame. Interior background: very deep midnight blue-black with restrained luminous atmospheric rays behind the object, a few tiny cyan particles, soft studio depth, no environment or room. Overall high-end collectible appearance and mythic prestige visibly beyond the existing ornate gold Emperor gear. Square 1536x1536-style high-resolution composition.
SUBJECT: A spectacular standalone UPPER-BODY ARMOR, empty neck opening through waist, integrated massive but elegant shoulderguards, compact upper-arm attachment plates, no helmet, head, wearer, full arms, hands or legs. A broad layered cathedral-of-technology chest silhouette with a large breathtaking recessed cyan-white triple concentric containment reactor at the sternum, precise orbital mechanical plates around the reactor, NOT a magic circle. White platinum heavy armor shell with branching polished pale-gold load-bearing seams, black recessed machinery, secondary precision segments floating a tiny controlled distance from the shoulders and upper back on visible energy couplings. Tall but restrained geometric collar and high proud shoulder architecture communicate supreme rank. Layered mechanical abdominal plates taper into a substantial armored waist. Several short parallel light rails follow actual armor contours. Sculptural and commanding, exquisitely engineered, no flimsy thin parts. Slight three-quarter front product view; entire armor fits comfortably within the ornate frame and fills roughly 78% of the interior. The equipment is the primary focus, the frame is clearly readable, neither overlaps the other.
